The '''Black Shred Water clan''' was a clan that operated with the individual [[Surdu]] as its stateman.<ref name="NEGC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Shred Water clan was first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="NEGC" />
